note: Synthetic evaluation set for the offline assistant (written by the FieldKit authors). Retrieval questions are paraphrases that avoid the entry titles' keywords where possible. Intent 'train' examples are the built-in prototypes shipped in app/src/assistant_intents.ts; 'test' utterances are held out. 'fresh_*' sets were written after the intent word cues were tuned on 'intents_test', to measure them honestly.
